job.title: Business Development Manager 2
job.description:
Our client is a major APAC based contractor in the construction, interiors, and manufacturing space with a reputable design arm.
 
The Director for Hong Kong is seeking a Business Development Manager with a solid background with solid connections in the commercial and retail space and interiors in Hong Kong.
 
We are seeking a Sales and Business Development Management professional who is already based in Hong Kong, with experience working with developers, design firms and contractors.
 
The key focus of this role is business development and sales. We are searching for a candidate with only circa 6 years of experience.
 
Seeking someone with a sales background.

  • Manage all marketing matters.
  • Devise a plan for sales strategies
  • Monitor sales performance
  • Oversee project installation
  • Drive new regions as in setting up new projects
Requirements:


  • Bachelors Degree in Administration, Project Management or Interiors
  • Only 6 years of experience is required, this is a management level role only, would be considered for a more senior role
  • Working experience in the real estate, interior or design fields is essential
  • Industry experience is preferably in retail, commercial or residential
  • Demonstrated experience in sales pitches
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Fluency in Cantonese and English is essential

job.title: Mandarin and English-Speaking Architectural Designer / PM (Retail projects) - Hong Kong
job.description:
Mandarin and English-Speaking Architectural Designer / PM (Retail projects) - Hong Kong

My client is a specialist architectural and interior design studio working on retail related projects.
 
They are looking for Revit capable designers and project managers for projects they are working on with retail brands.
 
The have roles in their project team for designers who will help in defining architectural / interior design solutions. You will the ability to develop concept designs through to design development and on into construction packages. The ideal candidate is expected to have at least 2-3 years related working experience for architectural / interior projects with some retail project experience
 
You will be able to handle full sets of tender / construction drawings and maintain a project schedule, coordinate and monitor site progress and lead coordination meetings with the Consultants and Clients. 
 
Strong software skills including REVIT with a good knowledge and interest in construction details.
 
Written and spoken English and spoken Putonghua is essential
 
Professional qualifications / experience preferred
 
A recognised degree in Architecture or Interior Design
Min 2-3 years related working experience
Interest in working on retail and store development projects
Good project management skills.
Ability to follow a project from concept through to completion with minimal guidance.
They are happy to support HK visa process if required for the right candidate.
 
Salary around 40K HKD per month
 
Please can you share your CV and portfolio if you may be interested in this

job.title: Project Manager - QS
job.description:
We are working with an international sub-contractor who possess a prestigious portfolio of clients globally.

The Director is expanding the team in Hong Kong, and we are searching for solid Project Manager with fit out backgrounds, preferably a QS by trade with some exposure to retail or corporate projects.

This person just be hands on, hard working with the ability to multitask and oversee a project to deadline and quality.

With the ability to take on the below responsibilities:
  • Supporting and assisting the Commercial and Project Management Teams in the implementation of strategic procedures, practices, and policies
  • Willing to work hands, on site and willing to lead teams internally and externally.
  • Developing and maintaining excellent working relationships with Project delivery teams, internal and external delivery partners, and the supply chain.
  • Ensuring contract documents are prepared in accordance with best practice and procedures and are fully executed prior to project commencement.
  • Ensuring appropriate methods are in place to identify change, implementing the change control process and agreement in line with contract requirements and commercial procedures.
  • Overseeing stakeholders and managing expectations.
Experience we are looking for:
  • You will need to have experience in corporate fit out works at a project level, be an excellent communicator both written and oral with relevant Quantity Surveying qualification, status and experience preferable.
  • Experience and knowledge of retail contracts is preferable however full training will be provided.
  • Hands on approach to managing projects.
  • Hong Kong work experience is preferable.
  • Ability to work in a demanding work environment.
